name: rated-presentation-edit
sql: UPDATE presentations SET date = $1, title = $2, venue = $3, presentation_type = $4, description = $5, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $6 AND resident_id = $7 RETURNING *

name: rated-presentation-delete
sql: DELETE FROM presentations WHERE id = $1 AND resident_id = $2 RETURNING id

name: resident-writes-supervisor-comment
sql: INSERT INTO general_comments (supervisor_id, resident_id, comment, is_anonymous) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4) RETURNING *

name: resident-reads-other-comments
sql: SELECT gc.*, u.name as supervisor_name FROM general_comments gc JOIN users u ON gc.supervisor_id = u.id WHERE gc.resident_id = $1 ORDER BY gc.created_at DESC

name: suspended-login
sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER($1)

name: year-change
sql: SELECT role FROM users WHERE id = $1
